title: 4.6.3 Update
description: Format your strategy notes, organize folders by game mode, and keep view cones aligned at every agent size.

changes.message: Add bold, italic, headings, bullet lists, and numbered lists to text on your strategies. Use the floating format bar while editing, or type Markdown shortcuts.
Choose game-mode logos for your folders from the new Modes tab: Competitive, Premier, Unrated, Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Spike Rush, and Escalation.
Read release notes anytime from What's new next to search in the library.
An Update available icon now stays at the top of the window while an update is waiting, so you can reopen the update dialog after dismissing it.
Find your installed Icarus version at the bottom of Settings. Click it to copy the version for a bug report.

Fixed view cones shifting away from agents and clipping incorrectly against walls when agent size changes. Cones now stay aligned while dragging and during page transitions, including in video exports.
